howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你系统性地测试网站或 API 中是否存在 IDOR 漏洞，包括识别高风险资产、枚举对象引用、测试跨用户/跨组织访问，以及利用 GraphQL 和 HTTP 方法篡改等高级技巧。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 帮助寻找 IDOR 漏洞，或提供目标 URL、API 端点、会话令牌等信息时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through systematically testing websites or APIs for IDOR vulnerabilities, including identifying high-risk assets, enumerating object references, testing cross-user/cross-org access, and advanced techniques like GraphQL and HTTP method tampering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help find IDOR vulnerabilities, or provide target URLs, API endpoints, session tokens, etc.
